Darwix Commercial Lending Handbook - 2026
Section 1: General Business Loan Eligibility Thresholds
This policy outlines the official underwriting thresholds for all commercial credit facilities.
1. Minimum Operating History: The borrowing business must have at least 6 months of verifiable operating history for
short-term working capital loans, and a minimum of 12 to 24 months for prime commercial term loans.
2. Minimum Gross Revenue: Businesses must demonstrate minimum average monthly gross revenues of ,000 (,000
annualized), verified via 3 to 6 months of official business checking bank statements.
3. Geographic Eligibility: The borrower entity must be registered and actively operating within any of the 50 United
States or the District of Columbia. Foreign entities are strictly ineligible.

documents.title: Section 2: Maximum Underwriting Leverage Matrix
documents.raw_content:
Section 2: Maximum Underwriting Leverage Matrix
Unsecured working capital facilities are evaluated against average monthly revenue ratios:
Monthly Revenue Max Unsecured Loan Maximum Leverage
,000 - ,000 ,000 - ,000 2.5x to 3.0x Revenue
,000 - ,000 ,000 - ,000 3.0x to 3.5x Revenue
,000 - ,000+ ,000 - ,000+ Up to 3.5x Revenue
Loans exceeding 4.0x monthly gross revenue are classified as excessive leverage and require immediate senior
underwriting review or equipment equity.

documents.title: Section 3: Ineligible and Restricted Industries
documents.raw_content:
Section 3: Ineligible and Restricted Industries
Under federal compliance and internal risk guidelines, Darwix strictly prohibits funding to businesses engaged in:
- Gambling operations, casinos, sports betting, and lottery ventures.
- Adult entertainment venues or novelty businesses.
- Cannabis, marijuana cultivation, or dispensaries.
- Cryptocurrency trading, speculative token mining, or crypto futures.
- Predatory payday lending or debt settlement organizations.
